title: Precision & Intelligence Update
headline: AI advisor improvements, weather location fix, performance tuning, and hardware detection across the board.
changes: Fixed: Weather widget showed wrong city and temperature — now resolves your actual location even when GPS isn't available, instead of silently falling back to London.
Fixed: NVIDIA Max Performance power plan showed as active (green) on AMD systems — the card now correctly shows as unavailable with no GPU-specific plan active.
Fixed: AI Advisor ignored phrases like 'I don't want GPU hardware scheduling' — excluded tweaks are now detected from plain language and skipped from the plan.
Fixed: Conflicting tweaks in the AI optimization plan had no way to be enabled — each conflict card now has an 'Include anyway' toggle so you can override the AI's decision.
Fixed: Dashboard hardware data re-fetched on every page navigation — specs now load once per session and return instantly on subsequent visits.
Fixed: Power Plan Advanced Overrides (Core Parking, Processor Boost, etc.) had no real effect — each now applies via powercfg and PowerShell with the correct GUID.
Fixed: App Booster optimization history didn't persist in the desktop app — session history is now stored and returned correctly without requiring a database.
Added: BIOS Advisor Hardware Profile now shows your detected CPU and GPU model alongside detected firmware settings.
